up-uhc: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
UHC tools (uhc/)              redistribution permitted by      https://uhc.megaburken.net/uhctools_os3.lha
                              the author (Patrik, UHC),        (mirrors: uhc.driar.se, uhc.a1k.org,
                              files unmodified                 uhc.no0b.de, uhc.hex9d.com)

Notes
- The files are the contents of the author's archive uhctools_os3.lha, unmodified: UP-Term changes,
  patches and re-builds nothing in it. UHC's author gave permission to redistribute it.
- The archive's SHA-256 is pinned in dist/addons/uhc/archives.txt of the UP-Term source.
